details.body:
stomer complaint

The external load will not turn on when the control input is HIGH. Restore switching on HIGH and off on LOW.

FUNCTIONAL RETEST

Check that the external load turns on with control HIGH and off with control LOW.

Examine the board and use the instruments to identify a repair. Switch off every supply and wait for stored energy to discharge before changing parts.

Accept ticket and start
